notes.title: Ver.1.0.4 Update (June 25, 2025)
notes.content:
Update Details:

1. Added "Tips" Button
 A help feature has been added to assist players when they get stuck in the game.
 It allows players to review what they should do next, such as selecting key points, changing the speaker, or adjusting the chronological order of statements.

2. Added Sound Effects to Controller Operations
 Cutscenes now progress automatically without requiring manual clicks each time.

3. Adjusted Certain Visual Effects
 Some video and visual effects have been fine-tuned.

notes.title: [Update Notice] Addition of Text Playback Speed Adjustment and Auto-Play for Cut
notes.content:
[Update Notice] Addition of Text Playback Speed Adjustment and Auto-Play for Cutscenes

Thank you for playing "Kindaichi Mystery Series: The Honjin Murders" and for your continued interest in the game.

An update was released today, May 15!

--------------------------------------
[b]Update Details:[/b]

[b]1. Added Text Playback Speed Adjustment[/b]
You can now adjust the "Text Speed" in the settings menu to change the playback speed of in-game text.

[b]2. Added Auto-Play for Cutscenes[/b]
During cutscenes, clicking "Auto" at the bottom right will enable auto-play mode, allowing scenes to progress automatically without having to click each time.

[b]3. Bug Fixes[/b]
Several known issues have been addressed and resolved.
--------------------------------------

These updates reflect some of the most commonly requested features from our players.
We hope you continue to enjoy the game!

And we hope you will continue to support "Kindaichi Mystery Series: The Honjin Murders"!

— The "Kindaichi Mystery Series: The Honjin Murders" Project Team

notes.title: (Important) Notification of Known Issues (Fixed)
notes.content:
[b]Fixed in the version released on May 15, 2025[/b]

Thank you for playing "Kindaichi Mystery Series: The Honjin Murders" and for your interest in the game.

We would like to inform you of a known issue.

In the current version, under certain conditions—such as performing "button mashing" (rapid, erratic inputs via keyboard or mouse), or repeatedly clicking the mouse at high speed—there is a rare chance that conversations may fail to link correctly, causing the game to become unprogressable.

If this occurs, please save your game in its current state, then reload from that save. This should restore the conversation links and allow you to continue playing.

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience. If you encounter this issue, we kindly ask you to follow the steps above to recover.

Thank you for your understanding and continued support.

— The "Kindaichi Mystery Series: The Honjin Murders" Project Team

notes.title: “Kindaichi Mystery Series: The Honjin Murders” launches today, April 24!
notes.content:
To everyone who added “Kindaichi Mystery Series: The Honjin Murders” to your wishlist—thank you so much.

We truly appreciate your patience.
[b]As of today, April 24, “Kindaichi Mystery Series: The Honjin Murders” is officially released![/b] (JST)

To celebrate the launch, [b]we’re offering the game at 15% off until May 7 as a special release promotion.[/b]

Additionally, [b]please note that our Content Distribution Guidelines were partially updated[/b] on April 21.
To enhance your content sharing experience, the following clause has been removed:

[i](Removed Clause)
• Monetization through paid distribution, tips, or any features involving direct or indirect financial transactions from viewers is prohibited.[/i]

For full details, please refer to the updated guideline page below:

[i]“Kindaichi Mystery Series: The Honjin Murders” Content Distribution Guidelines
https://colyinc.com/guideline/honjin/[/i]

We hope many of you will enjoy “Kindaichi Mystery Series: The Honjin Murders.”

— The “Kindaichi Mystery Series: The Honjin Murders” Project Team

notes.title: Content Distribution Guidelines
notes.content:
We welcome players to post and share gameplay screenshots and videos of “Kindaichi Mystery Series: The Honjin Murders.”
We hope you enjoy the game while respecting the guidelines outlined on this page.

[b]■ “Kindaichi Mystery Series: The Honjin Murders” Content Distribution Guidelines Page[/b]
https://colyinc.com/guideline/honjin/


Please note that this guideline was revised on April 21, 2025, with the following clause removed:
[i](Deleted Clause)
• Monetization through paid distribution, tips, or any features involving direct or indirect financial transactions from viewers is prohibited.
[/i]


[b]Please make sure to read and follow these Content Distribution Guidelines before sharing any content[/b].

[i]*The Content Distribution Guidelines page is currently available in Japanese only.
We apologize for the inconvenience and kindly ask that you refer to the Japanese version for now.
English and Simplified Chinese versions will be announced once they are ready.[/i]



[b]All parts of the guidelines are important, but we have selected and translated the most critical sections into multiple languages for your reference.[/b]

[b]■ Distribution Restrictions[/b]
Note: There are limitations on what parts of the game may be shared.

[b]Until May 7, 2025, 11:59 PM (JST)
Only gameplay screenshots and videos from Chapters 1 through 9 may be streamed or posted.
※Content from Chapter 10 onward through to the end of the game and the return to the title screen is strictly prohibited.

From May 8, 2025, 12:00 AM (JST)
Streaming and posting of gameplay screenshots and videos from all chapters is permitted.[/b]


[b]■ Regarding Spoilers[/b]
When posting content that includes important scenes or reveals core elements of the story, please be sure to include a clear spoiler warning such as "Spoiler Alert" or "Contains Spoilers" in a prominent location—such as the title, description, or within the video/stream itself.

The same care should be taken when sharing impressions or reviews of the game.
Please include appropriate spoiler warnings to ensure a considerate experience for other viewers.



[b]■"Company name, title name, copyright notice, and prohibition of reproduction/redistribution" must be clearly stated.[/b]
If you create a website or share official information using this game as a subject, please be sure to clearly include the following details in an easily visible location—such as the description section of a video—for your audience: company name, game title, copyright notice, and a statement prohibiting reproduction or redistribution.

Example:
[b]This page uses images from “Kindaichi Mystery Series: The Honjin Murders” by coly Inc.
Reproduction or redistribution of these images is strictly prohibited.
© Seishi Yokomizo 1973 © coly[/b]
[i]If the © symbol cannot be used, (C) may be substituted.[/i]


Thank you for your cooperation.

— The “Kindaichi Mystery Series: The Honjin Murders” Project Team

notes.title: Notice of the Release Date for “Kindaichi Mystery Series: The Honjin Murders”
notes.content:
To everyone who has added "Kindaichi Mystery Series: The Honjin Murders" to their wishlist—thank you very much.

We sincerely appreciate your patience.

We are pleased to announce that the official release date for "Kindaichi Mystery Series: The Honjin Murders" has been set for April 24, 2025.

Since the announcement of the delay, we’ve spent about a month polishing and refining the game. At last, we are ready to deliver it to you. We deeply apologize to everyone who has been waiting.

Additionally, we would like to inform you that we have received official approval from SOMI, the developer of the game "No Case Should Remain Unsolved" (Korean title: 미제사건은 끝내야 하니까), which served as a key inspiration for this project. We personally explained the content of our game to SOMI, who kindly gave their consent.

Our project team would like to express our heartfelt respect and gratitude to SOMI, and we will do our utmost to ensure that everyone enjoys this game.

Please bear with us just a little longer until the release on April 24.

— The "Kindaichi Mystery Series: The Honjin Murders" Project Team

notes.title: Notice of Release Postponement of “Kindaichi Mystery Series: The Honjin Murders”
notes.content:
Thank you very much to everyone who has added “Kindaichi Mystery Series: The Honjin Murders” to your wish list.

We have decided to postpone the game release, which was scheduled for March 20, 2025, in order to further brush up the game content.
Since the announcement on March 6, 2025, we have received a lot of great feedback from you all.
In order to ensure that everyone can play the game with peace of mind, we felt the need to further brush up on the game content and made the difficult decision to postpone the release.

We sincerely apologize to those of you who have been looking forward to the release of the game.

We will let you know once the release date has been finalized.
Thank you very much for your cooperation.

From the project team of Kindaichi Mystery Series: The Honjin Murders
